summary: Practise CBAM emissions calculations, supplier evidence controls, and documentation workflows. Explore the 5-day course and plan your training.
lede: CBAM readiness training helps trade and carbon-accounting professionals compile product emissions data and supporting records. Participants practise setting product boundaries, calculating embedded emissions from activity data, checking supplier evidence, and organizing documentation for importer–exporter handoffs. Exercises use sector examples and Excel-based registers to identify data gaps, track evidence, and build a readiness action plan; the course introduces verification review considerations but does not qualify participants to conduct independent assurance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who collect, calculate, review, or coordinate product emissions information and supporting records for CBAM-related trade.
modules: EU CBAM Scope and Trade Context
prerequisites: Working familiarity with export documentation, manufacturing data, sustainability reporting, or carbon accounting is recommended. Prior CBAM experience is not required. No coding or programming is required; practical exercises use structured worksheets and Excel.
